note: That Old Chestnut v0.3.0 chestnut detection. Every clause of a record's conduct note and reply quotes is scored against these rules (case-insensitive JavaScript RegExp). Clauses scoring >= min_clause get the crescendo highlight (level 1: <3, 2: 3-5, 3: >=6); a record whose best clause scores >= min_record joins the old-chestnuts list with that clause as its headline. overrides by record id: {"exclude":true} | {"include":true} | {"headline":"..."}; a record may also carry finding.chestnut (false | true | "headline"). Add rules here; toc.js carries the same list as its fallback.

kinds.scope: set aside as outside the request
kinds.challenge: came out after a new request, follow-up or challenge
kinds.found: records found after a not-held answer
kinds.nobasis: no record of why records were left out

rules.pattern: \b(?:withheld|left out|excluded|set aside|treated)\b[^.;]{0,40}\b(?:out of|outside(?: of)?)(?: the| our)? scope\b
\bnot considered to fall within the scope\b
\bno recorded basis\b|\bdoes not hold a separate (?:search log|record)\b|\bno separate record\b
\bafter the request and before the reply\b|\brelied on its new public availability\b|\bpublished\b[^.;]{0,40}\bafter\b
